title: Crochet Penguin Keychain
name: Penguin Keychain
seoTitle: Crochet Penguin Keychain Amigurumi Pattern (Free PDF)
description: Free crochet penguin keychain pattern: colourwork belly worked into the body, little wings, beak and feet. Printable PDF with counts for every round.
lead: A chubby penguin with a white belly that is worked right into the body rounds, so there is no belly patch to sew. Wings, beak and feet are small and quick.
yarn: Cotton yarn in a main colour (pink in my sample), white and yellow

materialsTable.details: Cotton yarn in a main colour (pink in my sample), white (belly) and yellow (beak and feet)

notes: From round 7 the belly is worked in white. Carry the colour you are not using inside the body.
Body rounds end with a sl st.

(2 sc, dec) x8. Stuff the body.
(sc, dec) x8
dec x8. Close the body and finish with a needle.
With the main colour: 6 sc in a magic ring.
(sc, inc) x3
ch 1, 9 sc, sl st (3 rounds)
ch 1, (sc, dec) x3, sl st
ch 1, fold flat and join both sides with a sc in each st, sl st. Fasten off.
4 sc in a magic ring. Cut the yarn.
4 sc in a magic ring, sl st.
(sc, inc) x2, sl st. Cut the yarn.

finishing: Add the eyes on the white face part, a few rounds apart.
Sew the beak between the eyes, the wings on the sides and the feet at the bottom.
Attach the keyring to the top of the head.
